headline: Apple unveils new M5 MacBook lineup with on-device AI features
text: Apple Inc. announced the M5 MacBook Pro and Air, highlighting private on-device AI for summarization and coding assistants. Analysts say the move strengthens Apple's AI story without heavy cloud spend.

headline: AAPL services revenue hits record as App Store and Apple TV grow
text: Apple reported record services revenue driven by App Store subscriptions and Apple TV+. Investors view recurring services as a stabilizer for AAPL margins amid hardware cycles.

headline: Microsoft Azure AI capacity expands with new OpenAI partnership terms
text: Microsoft said Azure will add more GPU regions to meet demand for Copilot and OpenAI workloads. MSFT reiterated that AI is the largest driver of Azure growth this year.

headline: MSFT Teams adds enterprise RAG connectors for SharePoint and OneDrive
text: Microsoft rolled out retrieval-augmented generation connectors so Teams Copilot can cite SharePoint and OneDrive documents with permissions preserved.

headline: NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs see strong demand from cloud hyperscalers
text: NVIDIA reported that Blackwell GPU shipments are booked through mid-2027 as AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud race for AI training capacity. NVDA remains the key supplier for large language model clusters.

headline: NVDA announces CUDA software updates for financial risk models
text: NVIDIA released CUDA toolkit updates aimed at banks and hedge funds running Monte Carlo and market risk simulations on GPUs, expanding beyond pure AI training use cases.

headline: Supply chain notes: iPhone camera modules face short delay in Asia
text: A short delay in camera module shipments may nudge some iPhone production into early November. Apple said demand remains solid and the impact on AAPL fiscal guidance is limited.

headline: Microsoft earns big deal for government cloud and security suites
text: A multi-year US public-sector contract covering Microsoft 365, Defender, and Azure Government boosts MSFT's backlog in regulated workloads.

headline: Why is NVDA mentioned in every AI earnings call this season?
text: Companies across software and cloud keep citing NVIDIA GPUs as a bottleneck and a growth enabler. Analysts say NVDA's visibility in earnings transcripts reflects its central role in the AI stack.

headline: MSFT stock dips after mixed Windows OEM commentary
text: Microsoft shares slipped briefly after a partner hinted at softer PC OEM volumes, though Azure and AI commentary remained upbeat for MSFT long-term holders.
